newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed,trade lacks direction.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed,trade lacks direction.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Thursday, as some contracts recovered from earlier losses in trade that lacked a clear direction, local traders said.
Prices ranged from 80 yen lower to 80 yen higher, with the July 1998 contract down 80 yen at 13,700 yen a tonne. The estimated volume was 42,717 lots.
All months fell during the morning, reflecting the CBOT corn market's price losses overnight, traders said. But technical buying supported the market later, they said.
"Investors were more interested in the soybean market, and they couldn't find a clear direction in the corn market today," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.66-1/4 per bushel at 0805 GMT, against $2.66-1/2 at Wednesday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean was traded at $7.62 per bushel at 0805 GMT, down from $7.82 at Wednesday's close.
